abstract: Quantitative serial serum measurements of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) levels using sensitive double-antibody radioimmunoassays were performed in nine patients with germinal cell tumors before and during treatment. The sera of eight of the nine were found to have a hCG marker and five of the nine an AFP marker. The sera of four patients were found to have both. Serial serum levels of hCG, of AFP, or both were useful for monitoring disease activity during therapy in all nine patients. In two patients tumor masses failed to diminish during chemotherapy, but the tumor markers fell appropriately. At surgery one patient had a mature teratoma, the other a mature teratoma with a microscopic focus of an embryonal cell tumor. In one patient tumor reactivation was reflected by the emergence of only one of two previously elevated tumor markers. One patient had a rise in hCG, another a rise in both markers coincident with recurrence of tumor. Serial measurements of AFP and hCG are useful for following the response to therapy of germinal tumors, and can assist in making therapeutic decisions.
abstract_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の患者9例について、治療前と治療中に二重抗体ラジオイムノアッセイを用いて、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の血清値を定量的に連続測定した。9例中8例でhCGマーカーが、5例でAFPマーカーが認められ、4例は両方が認められた。全例で連続的な血清値が疾患活動性の監視に有用であった。2例では化学療法中に腫瘍塊が縮小しなかったが、腫瘍マーカーは適切に低下した。手術時には、1例で成熟奇形腫、別の1例で成熟奇形腫と微小な胚細胞性腫瘍の病巣が認められた。1例では、以前に上昇していた2つのマーカーのうち1つだけが再び出現することで腫瘍の再活性化が示された。1例ではhCGが上昇し、別の1例では腫瘍の再発と同時に両マーカーが上昇した。AFPとhCGの連続測定は、胚細胞性腫瘍の治療反応の追跡に有用であり、治療上の判断の助けとなりうる。
